_comment: Single source of truth for every dollar figure, threshold, percentage, citation, and deadline. NEVER write a value from memory. Fetch the primary source (irs.gov, tax.ny.gov, nysenate.gov), then fill value, tax_year, as_of (YYYY-MM-DD date checked), source, and source_url. Until verified, value stays null and status is TODO(verify). Pages read from this file and render a visible 'as of' date. See CLAUDE.md.

ny_basic_exclusion.label: New York estate tax basic exclusion amount
ny_basic_exclusion.source: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
ny_basic_exclusion.note: NY has its own estate tax, separate from and far lower than the federal exclusion, with a 'cliff' — the mechanism, not the number, is the durable content.

ny_estate_tax_cliff_multiplier.label: New York estate tax cliff (share of exclusion above which the full estate is taxed)
ny_estate_tax_cliff_multiplier.source: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
ny_estate_tax_cliff_multiplier.note: Above a threshold multiple of the exclusion, the exclusion phases out entirely and the whole estate is taxed. Verify the current multiple and mechanics.

federal_estate_gift_exclusion.label: Federal unified estate and gift tax exclusion (per person)

federal_gift_annual_exclusion.label: Federal gift tax annual exclusion (per recipient, per year)

scpa_1726.label: NY SCPA § 1726 — standby guardian designation
scpa_1726.source: New York Consolidated Laws, Surrogate's Court Procedure Act
